authors: J.M. Henn, G.P. Korchemsky, B. Mistlberger
title: The full four-loop cusp anomalous dimension in N=4 super Yang-Mills and QCD
journal: JHEP 04 (2020) 018 (from memory; no journal listed on fetched page)
claim: The complete four-loop cusp anomalous dimension (including the 1/N^2 part) in N=4 SYM is obtained analytically by computing the finite ratio <W L(x0)>/<W> for a rectangular light-like Wilson loop with a Lagrangian insertion to three loops with full colour, then integrating over the insertion point to get the four-loop divergence; the QCD result follows by a supersymmetric decomposition.
scheme: The key object (Wilson loop with Lagrangian insertion) is finite in N=4 and computed without regulator; DR presumably enters only in the final integration over the insertion point (not stated in the abstract).
symmetry_argument: Finiteness and dual conformal covariance of the Lagrangian-insertion ratio in N=4; supersymmetric decomposition of QCD (gluon + gluino + scalar contributions).

assumed: Validity of the Lagrangian insertion relation between the integrated three-loop insertion and the four-loop Wilson-loop divergence; finiteness of the ratio (stated).

evidence: Abstract: method via finite function of a cross-ratio; ancillary HPL files.
red_flags: Only abstract read: the regularization used for the final integration is not verified here.
notes: Optional lead; correct id. Journal from memory.
